title: The Steady job at the mill
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：steady　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 steady 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the grandmother wrote of ① a steady job at the mill in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② steadier than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the steady ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the steadiest job at the mill anybody in the courtyard had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too steady to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the steady ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a steady hand of the old man, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as steady as the hand of the old man they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was steady or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something steady, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite steady; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the steady ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, in public, she wrote of another steady job at the mill in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ steadier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The steadiest hand of the old man in the whole courtyard, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the steady ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 稳定（前置定语 a steady job at the mill：1980 年祖母在日记里记下的那件稳定的工作）
B. adj. 稳定／稳当（比较级 steadier than：文中两处，一处比磨坊里稳定的工作，一处比预想）
C. adj. 稳定／稳当（最高级 the steadiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 稳定（表语 too steady to do：母亲觉得它太稳定，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 稳当（前置定语 a steady hand of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩稳当的手）
F. adj. 稳当（同级比较 as steady as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人稳当的手相比）
G. adj. 稳当（后置定语 something steady：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 稳当（受程度副词修饰 quite steady：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a steady job at the mill
the steadiest job at the mill anybody
a steady hand of the old man
The steadiest hand of the old man in

answers.why: steady 意为“稳定”，1980 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件稳定的工作”，此处作前置定语 a steady job at the mill。
steady 意为“稳定”，此处用比较级 steadier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
steady 意为“稳定”，日记上 二月 那行字说它是院子里最稳定的一件，故用最高级 the steadiest job at the mill。
steady 意为“稳定”，母亲认为这件东西“太稳定了，谁也用不上”，too steady to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
steady 意为“稳当”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩稳当的手”，此处作前置定语 a steady hand of the old man。
steady 意为“稳当”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人稳当的手一样稳当”，同级比较用 as steady as。
steady 意为“稳当”，日记上那半行字要的是“稳当的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something steady。
steady 意为“稳当”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当稳当”，quite 修饰原级 steady。
steady 意为“稳当”，1990 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要稳当”，故用比较级 steadier than。
steady 意为“稳当”，母亲 1992 年说的是“整个院子里最稳当的那一桩”，故用最高级 the steadiest hand of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件稳定的工作。（a steady job at the mill）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更稳定。（steadier than …）
母亲觉得它太稳定，谁也用不上。（too steady to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩稳当的手。（a steady hand of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人稳当的手一样稳当。（as steady as …）
到了 1987 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件稳当的东西。（something steady）
answers: In 1980 the grandmother wrote of a steady job at the mill in the diary.
Everybody said it was steadier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too steady to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a steady hand of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as steady as the hand of the old man they had once had.
By 1987 the diary asked for nothing but something steady.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 steady 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the grandmother wrote of a steady job at the mill in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the steadiest job at the mill in the courtyard, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too steady to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a steady hand of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite steady, and everybody laughed.
The steady ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
